name: Indices Tester
summary: Indices Tester is an Expert Advisor designed to test and trade index instruments (such as S&P 500, NASDAQ, DOW) using multi-indicator signal generation. It evaluates multiple technical indicators across different timeframes to generate entry and exit signals specifically tuned for index CFDs. The EA provides parameterized settings for indicator periods and risk management to allow backtesting optimization on index instruments.
summary_zh: Indices Tester是一个专为指数品种（如标普500、纳斯达克、道琼斯）设计的EA，使用多指标信号生成机制进行测试和交易。它在多个时间框架上评估多种技术指标，生成专门针对指数CFD优化的入场和出场信号。该EA提供参数化的指标周期和风险管理设置，便于对指数品种进行回测优化。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于多指标融合信号系统，针对指数品种的特性进行优化。入场条件通常结合趋势指标（如均线交叉）和动量指标（如RSI超买超卖、MACD金叉死叉）的共振信号，在多个时间框架上确认趋势方向后入场。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、指标反向信号出场以及移动止损保护利润。仓位管理采用基于账户余额的固定比例手数计算方式，支持参数化调整每笔交易的风险比例。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓数限制和单日最大亏损限制等防护机制，但缺乏马丁格尔或网格机制，属于较为保守的系统化策略。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on a multi-indicator confluence signal system optimized for the characteristics of index instruments. Entry conditions typically combine trend indicators (such as moving average crossovers) and momentum indicators (such as RSI overbought/oversold levels and MACD signal line crossovers), requiring confirmation across multiple timeframes before opening a position. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, indicator reversal signals, and trailing stop mechanisms to protect accumulated profits. Position sizing employs an account balance-based fixed percentage lot calculation, with parameterized adjustment for the risk percentage per trade. Money management includes protective mechanisms such as maximum open position limits and daily maximum loss limits, but lacks Martingale or grid components, making it a relatively conservative systematic strategy.
pros: 专门针对指数品种优化，参数选择符合指数市场波动特性
多指标共振过滤假信号，入场质量较高
提供完整的止损止盈和仓位管理参数，风险可控
支持回测优化，参数可调性强
多时间框架确认机制减少逆势交易概率
pros_en: Specifically optimized for index instruments with parameters suited to index market volatility characteristics
Multi-indicator confluence filters out false signals, resulting in higher quality entries
Provides complete stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing parameters for controllable risk
Supports backtesting and optimization with highly adjustable parameters
Multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism reduces probability of counter-trend trades
cons: 缺乏点差过滤机制，在指数点差较大时可能产生滑点亏损
未检测新K线形成，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
策略逻辑相对简单，在震荡市中可能频繁止损
缺少市场状态识别机制，无法自动区分趋势和震荡行情
对数据质量依赖较高，回测结果可能存在过拟合风险
cons_en: Lacks spread filter mechanism, potentially causing slippage losses when index spreads are wide
No new bar detection, which may lead to repeated entries on the same candle
Strategy logic is relatively simple and may suffer frequent stop-outs in ranging markets
Missing market regime identification, unable to automatically distinguish trending from ranging conditions
High dependency on data quality with risk of overfitting in backtesting results
improvements: 增加市场状态识别模块（如ADX或波动率过滤器），在震荡行情中减少交易频率
添加新K线检测机制和点差过滤，避免重复开仓和高成本交易
improvements_en: Add market regime identification module (such as ADX or volatility filter) to reduce trade frequency in ranging conditions
Implement new bar detection mechanism and spread filter to prevent repeated entries and high-cost trades

risk_points: 缺少新K线检测可能导致同一根K线上多次开仓，增加风险敞口
未设置点差过滤，指数品种点差扩大时可能造成额外损失
缺乏市场状态识别，震荡行情中趋势策略可能连续止损
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar detection may cause multiple entries on the same candle, increasing risk exposure
No spread filter set, potentially causing additional losses when index spreads widen
Absence of market regime identification may lead to consecutive stop-outs in ranging markets

It evaluates multiple technical indicators across different timeframes to generate entry and exit signals specifically tuned for index CFDs. The EA provides parameterized settings for indicator periods and risk management to allow backtesting optimization on index instruments.
